Name: Abel-mizraim
ModernLocation: Near the mouth of the Jordan River
Description: The place beyond the Jordan where the Canaanites saw the Egyptians mourning for Jacob at the threshingfloor of Atad, and named it Abel-mizraim, 'the mourning of the Egyptians'.
BiblicalSignificance: Abel-mizraim marks the grief of Jacob's burial journey: Egypt's mourning witnessed by Canaan, on the way to the cave of Machpelah.
